◉　Plot

　　50-year-old Kensho Aoto went through a divorce and returned to his hometown. He begins to work for a
　　printing company and lives a quiet life. He has an encounter with Yoko Sudo, whom he last saw 35 years
　　ago in middle school. Yoko is widowed and makes a living by doing part-time work. They spend time
　　together and become attracted to each other.
